title: POSTCARDS FROM THE OTHER TOWN · III
venue: Arthur's site · a romance the strip never ran · eight cards · Box 19
logline: Hers: the front is the lighthouse's lamp room from inside, the lens enormous, the coast tiny in every prism; the back, one word.

panels.composition: The postcard's front: the inside of a lighthouse's lamp room with the lens enormous and the coast repeated tiny in every prism.

image.prompt: two-color coastal weekly illustration, the inside of a lighthouse lamp room with an enormous lens repeating a tiny coastline in every prism, no words legible

panels.name: Front

panels.composition: The postcard's back: the message side with a small drawing of a bus in the corner in her hand, the third word legible.

image.prompt: the back of a postcard drawn in ink, a divided back with an address side and a message side, the handwriting rendered as strokes with one word left legible, a small stamp with a tiny numeral in its corner, a small drawn bus in the message's corner, no words legible but one
image.notes: The lens repeats the coast: the device of the fronts is scale. The one legible word: were. Stamp numeral: II.

panels.name: Back

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink for the fronts; the backs in a stranger's hand, drawn as shapes but for one word each
art.palette: the fronts in the coastal weekly's two-color; the stamps in one color each
art.paper: cardstock cut to postcard size, drawn both sides, photographed as spreads
